content: To paraphrase the great bard BIBREF21, there is something rotten in the state of the art. We propose Human-And-Model-in-the-Loop Entailment Training (HAMLET), a training procedure to automatically mitigate problems with current dataset collection procedures (see Figure FIGREF1).
